development_amendments.reason: The declarative electrochemical mechanism and runtime previously described different worlds.

development_amendments.reason: A normalized unit vector is not a scientifically interpretable model interface.
development_amendments.change: The model selects named controls with units; deterministic unit-vector encoding remains internal for baseline compatibility.

development_amendments.reason: Free-text mechanism explanations cannot be compared reproducibly to the instantiated world.
development_amendments.change: Require evidence-grounded structured observable causal claims and score them against a frozen hidden reference graph.

development_amendments.reason: Declared mechanism claims alone do not establish that the model can predict unseen interventions.
development_amendments.change: Add three frozen one-factor held-out direction queries to the existing final synthesis call, followed by twelve paired local simulations with no feedback to the model.
